args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding per FIN-212

round_money documented ROUND_HALF_EVEN but actually used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing nightly build failures in tests/test_money.py.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN as specified in FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in src/money.py documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but was implemented with ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py, which expects e.g. 2.665 → 2.66.

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so behavior matches FIN-212 and the test expectations.

## Validation
- CI run ci-0001 passed on commit 08d3cd5986.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
